newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - B&G FOODS SELLS $120 MLN 144A NOTES.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - B&G FOODS SELLS $120 MLN 144A NOTES.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from B&G Foods was priced in the private placement market on Wednesday, via lead manager Lehman Brothers, according to a market source.
The deal was increased to $120 million from an original size of $100 million, the source added.
TYPE SNR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 2/1/1998
LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 9.625 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS SPREAD +340 BPS CALLABLE NON-CALL FIVE
NOTE: The notes have a three-year equity call for 35 percent of the issue at 109.625.
(( Caryn Trokie, U.S. corporate bond unit, 212-859-1678 ))
